Maya Chen: Heads-up — QBR with Solstice Corp next Wed 10am PT. Need final slide deck, exec asks (2 min), and renewal risk summary. Can we run a quick scrub today?

Sam Park: I'll owner the renewal risk heatmap. Quick ask — do we want to surface the cost savings from batching changes?

```

Ticket #CS-1421
```

cs-bot: Reminder: QBR template v2 is at https://internal.redwood.com/qbr/templates/v2 — last updated 2026-03-10 :spiral_calendar:

• Intro: 18 months of partnership, 42% growth in API usage
• Top metric: Latency SLO met 99.6% last quarter
• Ask 1: Expand Dedicated trial to 3 additional teams
• Ask 2: Monthly EBR cadence for platform roadmap alignment
• Fallback: Offer limited burst capacity while Dedicated ramps
Priya Singh: LGTM — suggest replacing '42%' with month-over-month usage trend subplot. More concrete.
Jorge Alvarez: I'll update the slides and re-upload to the runbook.
Maya Chen: Meeting owners = Maya (exec), Jorge (deck), Priya (data), Sam (risk), Nina (ask wording). Please upload final deck by EOD today.
Nina Patel: I'll do a final language pass after Jorge uploads.
Sam Park: I'm also prepping a one-slide 'risk mitigation plan' with timings and owners.
Maya Chen: Great. After EOD scrub we'll do a 20-min dry run tomorrow 9:30am PT. Can everyone confirm availability?
Priya Singh: Confirmed.
